query_parameters.query: select source_id,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,pmra,pmra_error,pmdec,pmdec_error,parallax_pmra_corr,parallax_pmdec_corr,pmra_pmdec_corr,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,ruwe,ipd_frac_multi_peak,duplicated_source,visibility_periods_used,radial_velocity,radial_velocity_error,b from gaiadr3.gaia_source where parallax between 0.5 and 0.98 and parallax_over_error>15 and phot_g_mean_mag<16.5 and pm>10 and ruwe<1.4 and abs(b)>30 and ra between 0 and 5 and dec between -60 and -40
